title: claudeUsage signal
description: UNOFFICIAL, opt-in (providers.claude_usage.enabled, else 404). Claude Code usage meters, read either from an undocumented cache field of ~/.claude.json (source 'cache', re-read every 30 s) or from the stdout of the user's own command (source 'command', every interval_minutes, min 2). GET /api/signals/claude-usage, polled every 30 s. Only percentages and reset times leave the server. May break at any time. SENSITIVE.

rows.description: One row per meter that has a number.

resets.description: When the meter resets, ISO 8601 with offset (may carry microseconds), or null.

fetched.description: When the numbers were produced (cache: fetchedAtMs/1000, 0 if unknown; command: run time). Unix time in seconds (float). Use it to mark stale data.

error.description: Optional: why the command failed (rows then come from the cache). Short, never contains secrets.
